_doc: Partner coastal market coverage research candidates. This is the missing upstream research layer: public partner operations -> normalized source markets -> exact Atlas binding or gap triage. Existing partner buckets are not treated as comprehensive.
rules: Do not infer country/bucket coverage into city IDs without city-level source/provenance.
Bind only exact registry key, exact alias, or documented provenance; null beats confidently-wrong.
Unbound source markets become shared alias/provenance/registry-expansion triage, not partner-specific fake/null markets.
Economics readiness is tracked separately and does not gate display.
